Primate & Gorilla • Private Tailored

Primates of the Pearl: Chimpanzees, Gorillas & Golden Monkeys

The definitive three-primate quest through Kibale rainforest, Bwindi cloud forest, and the volcanic slopes of Mgahinga.

Duration 7 Days / 6 Nights
Private From $4,600 / person
Physical Demand Moderate to Challenging
Vehicle Standard Custom 4x4 Land Cruiser
Expedition Overview Key Highlights Day-by-Day Route Inclusions
Inquire for This Safari
Detailed Overview

About This Expedition

Uganda is universally recognized as Africa's greatest primate sanctuary. This focused 7-day itinerary tracks three of the continent's most iconic primate species: habituated eastern chimpanzees in Kibale, mountain gorillas in Bwindi, and endangered golden monkeys on the bamboo slopes of Mount Gahinga.

Best Season for This Route

Year-round; premier dry months June to August and December to February

Curated Highlights

What Makes This Journey Unrivaled

Kibale National Park chimpanzee tracking with senior primatologist
Mountain Gorilla tracking permit in the mist-veiled forests of Bwindi
Golden Monkey tracking in the bamboo forests of Mgahinga Gorilla National Park
Spectacular views of the three dormant Virunga volcanoes: Muhavura, Gahinga, and Sabinyo
Boutique eco-lodges with heated fireplaces and private forest verandas
Day-by-Day Narrative

Detailed Expedition Plan

7 Days Planned
Day 1

Entebbe to Kibale Forest Highlands

Early departure from Entebbe heading west into the tea terraces and tropical woodlands of Kibale Forest.

Accommodation: Ndali Crater Lodge or Primate Lodge Kibale
Meal Plan: Lunch, Dinner
Day 2

Kibale Forest Chimpanzee Encounter

Morning guided tracking of habituated chimpanzees. Observe their grooming, canopy feeding, and vocal pant-hoots.

Accommodation: Ndali Crater Lodge or Primate Lodge Kibale
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
Day 3

Scenic Traverse to Southern Bwindi Highlands

Overland journey south through Queen Elizabeth savanna and mountain passes into the mist of southern Bwindi.

Accommodation: Clouds Mountain Gorilla Lodge or Four Gorillas Lodge
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
Day 4

Bwindi Mountain Gorilla Tracking Expedition

Follow expert rangers into primary jungle to spend one profound hour with a wild mountain gorilla family.

Accommodation: Clouds Mountain Gorilla Lodge or Four Gorillas Lodge
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
Day 5

Mgahinga Bamboo Slopes and Golden Monkey Tracking

Short drive to Mgahinga Gorilla National Park. Hike into the high-altitude bamboo zone to track troops of lively, endangered golden monkeys.

Accommodation: Mount Gahinga Lodge
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
Day 6

Lake Bunyonyi Rest and Dugout Canoe Exploration

Transfer to tranquil Lake Bunyonyi, framed by terraced green hills. Enjoy an afternoon canoe exploration and peaceful sunset.

Accommodation: BirdNest Resort (Lake Bunyonyi)
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner
Day 7

Return to Entebbe via the Equator Line

Scenic return drive to Entebbe with a traditional lunch stop at Igongo Cultural Center, arriving in Entebbe for evening departures.

Accommodation: Outbound flight departure
Meal Plan: Breakfast, Lunch
